HR Manager
Responsibilities Requirements

Work closely with the team to define roles and review candidates, source and screen candidates from various channels.
Build and manage Employee onboarding process.
Manage recruitment and interview processes. Conduct initial introduction calls for various positions and perform reference calls. 
Manage team calendar, plan and execute team building events. Schedule and coordinate conferences, events, travel and other similar activities. Ensure a high level of employee engagement.
Work with our team to execute cignal’ HR strategy, vision and values.
Be the point of contact for all HR issues related to the entire employee lifecycle

  • Out-of-the-box recruitment methods
  • 2 years + experience in a growing startup!
  • Experience in recruitment processes and applicant tracking systems is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills required with strong interpersonal skills
  • You are a team player who knows when to act independently and when to seek a second opinion
  • Ability to learn new concepts quickly
  • Ability to multi-task, set priorities and work in a dynamic office environment
  • Excellent proactive follow-up skills is required
  • Must be organized and detail-oriented
  • Must have the ability to appropriately manage confidential information.
  • Extensive experience in HR interviewing
  • A keen sense of understanding of core business goals and priorities
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

Technical Account Manager
Responsibilities Requirements

Become an expert with cignal’ proprietary technology. Manage the onboarding, integration, support, and optimization of CORE partners - SSPs, DSPs,
DMPs and direct programmatic buyers and sellers. Build relationships with technical and business contacts on Demand and Supply side, establishing
yourself as a trusted advisor on all aspects of the programmatic ecosystem. Lead revenue initiatives related to programmatic partners.
Provide expert level guidance to DSPs and SSPs on CORE console; knowing our offering’s full
potential to be able to advise on the best technical solutions.
Analyze large sets of performance data and communicate findings to internal teams and external
partners.
Debug and diagnose day to day CORE’s partners to resolve technical issues. Help improve our operations workflow through the development of new processes and best-practices.
Suggest, and at times directly improve and create CORE’s external documentation and
collateral materials set, including API specs, FAQ, partner procedure guides, etc.
Communicate internally and externally the status and on-going timeline for integrations.

  • 2 years+ of experience in the programmatic advertising space, with a management position.
  • A strong understanding of OpenRTB protocol, DSPs, SSPs, Exchanges, DMPs & Measurement Providers
  • Demonstrated ability to use data to troubleshoot and solve complex problems autonomously
  • Business savvy with Proven success in managing client relationships
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to respond quickly in a fast-moving environment
  • Experience in management of programmatic ad delivery, optimization and/or yield management
  • Working with tech implementation and tagging integrations.
  • Proven experience working on RTB integrations
  • Ability to convey complex technical requirements and ideas to both technical and commercially focused positions internally and externally
  • Experience in diagnosing and working through issues with third-party technology vendors including DSPs, DMPs, and ad servers
  • Curious and aptitude for working with new emerging technologies and partnering with market leaders to drive solutions to fit partner’s business needs

Data Scientist
Responsibilities Requirements

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join its science team, responsible for implementing deep learning algorithms on sparse, heterogeneous and trending data, discovering problems insights and identifying opportunities through the use of statistical, algorithmic, mining and visualization techniques. In addition to advanced analytic skills. This role is also proficient at integrating and preparing large, varied datasets, architecting specialized database and computing environments, and communicating results.

  • Conduct undirected research and frame open-ended industry questions
  • Extract huge volumes of data from multiple internal and external sources
  • Employ sophisticated analytics programs, machine learning and statistical methods to prepare data for use in predictive and prescriptive modeling
  • Thoroughly clean and prune data to discard irrelevant information
  • Explore and examine data from a variety of angles to determine hidden weaknesses, trends and/or opportunities
  • Devise data-driven solutions to the most pressing challenges
  • Invent new algorithms to solve problems and build new tools to automate work
  • Communicate predictions and findings to management and IT departments through effective data visualizations and reports
  • Recommend cost-effective changes to existing procedures and strategies

  • Build high-performance algorithms, prototypes, predictive models and proof of concepts

  • Develop data set processes for data modeling, mining and production
  • Integrate new data management technologies and software engineering tools into existing structures
  • Create custom software components  and analytics applications
  • Employ a variety of languages and tools  to marry systems together
  • Install and update disaster recovery procedures
  • Recommend ways to improve data reliability, efficiency and quality
